topic.title: Create Tags
topic.shortdesc: Create tags to mark specific points in repository history, such as release commits.

body.p: Use tags to capture a specific point in history, such as a release. A tag is similar to a branch, but it does not change. You can create tags from the Git History view contextual menu.

To manage tags, use the Show tags action from the Ellipsis (three vertical dots) menu in the Git Staging view or from the Git main menu. This action opens a dialog box that lists all tags. You can delete local and pushed tags. For tags that exist only in the local branch, you can push them to the remote repository.
